evidence: NOTE: Focused tests passed (30 tests: retrieval-coverage schema, concept-registry schema regression, SDK regression). The implementation receipt validates.
NOTE: palimnex/schemas/retrieval-coverage.v1.schema.json differs from the accepted Phase 0 schema only by dropping Draft from the title. Identifier, $defs, $refs, fields, and meaning are unchanged.

NOTE: explain-search.v1 has exactly the seven specified keys, additionalProperties false, search as type object, coverage as $ref or null, and if/then tying coverage null to registry_absent. Valid enabled and registry_absent fixtures validate; extra key, null-while-enabled, present-while-absent, and authorizes_actions true are rejected.

NOTE: Accepted Phase 0 coverage examples are byte-identical in palimnex/tests/fixtures/retrieval_coverage. docs/COVERAGE_RECEIPT.md records the reader obligation, status table, R7, R10 retrieve_sources sibling, and CLI defaults.

NOTE: Draft 2020-12 JSON Schema accepts the overlap fixture and float-ratio 0.0; palimnex.coverage.validate_receipt refuses them (classification_overlap, invalid_integer). Schema-lane tests add coverage_contract_errors for integer type, disjointness, and digest. That split is expected and is not a silent accept of those invalid documents.
NOTE: registry.path uses the repository traversal-free pattern (no leading /, no .., max 512). The CLI also refuses backslash and NUL; the schema does not. Producer output never contains those paths.
source_grounding_result: Public coverage schema $refs conceptId, alias, and projectIdentity from concept-registry.v1 and locators from source-locator.v1 through a local referencing.Registry. No network $ref resolution.
privacy_result: Both schemas require authority evidence_only and authorizes_actions false. Coverage has query_digest only. Registry paths are bounded and traversal-free. Fixtures contain no credential-shaped literals.
retrieval_quality_result: The wrapper does not constrain search beyond type object, matching EXPLAIN_SEARCH_SPEC.md. Coverage collections, integer coverage, truncation flags, and semantic disclosure consts match the accepted contract.
compatibility_result: Additive identifiers palimnex:retrieval-coverage:v1 and palimnex:explain-search:v1. test_sdk public_wire_schemas still passes. No project-memory:* or existing schema change. pyproject.toml already packages schemas/*.json.
rollback_result: Delete the two public schema files, their tests and fixtures, and docs/COVERAGE_RECEIPT.md. Existing readers are unaffected.
authority_result: Schemas cannot authorize actions. Documentation states the document is printed, never persisted, and does not alter search or context v1.
limitations: Full suite and palimnex_check.sh were not run, as instructed.
